create_tester_instance: create a BoostBuild.Tester instance to set up a test environment for custom generator validation
write_test_fixture: write a test fixture file such as jamroot.jam or rcc.jam using the tester write method
run_build_system: run the Boost.Build system against the test fixtures to verify custom generator behavior
expect_file_content: expect specific content in a generated output file like bin/r.obj to confirm the generator action succeeded
cleanup_test_artifacts: cleanup all test artifacts and temporary files created during the Boost.Build test run
